pick.headline: Hugo Chavez leads failed coup in Venezuela
pick.summary: On 4 February 1992 army officers led by Lieutenant Colonel Hugo Chavez attempted to overthrow President Carlos Andres Perez; the coup failed within hours and Chavez surrendered on television.
pick.significance: The attempt revealed the fragility of one of Latin America's oldest democracies and made Chavez a national figure who would be elected president in 1998.
